description: This file contains utility functions for generating OpenAPI schema components in FastAPI, including path and operation definitions, parameter extraction, and response schemas.

classes.name: OpenAPI
classes.description: Model representing the OpenAPI schema structure.

methods.name: get_openapi_security_definitions
methods.description: Generates security definitions and security requirements for an API operation based on dependencies.

methods.name: _get_openapi_operation_parameters
methods.description: Extracts and constructs OpenAPI parameter objects from route dependencies.

methods.name: get_openapi_operation_request_body
methods.description: Creates the OpenAPI requestBody object from a route's body field.

methods.name: generate_operation_id
methods.description: Generates a unique operationId for an API route, deprecated in favor of other methods.

methods.name: generate_operation_summary
methods.description: Creates a summary for an API operation, defaulting to route name.

methods.name: get_openapi_operation_metadata
methods.description: Builds the metadata object for an API operation, including tags, summary, description, and operationId.

methods.name: get_openapi_path
methods.description: Constructs the OpenAPI path item object for a given route, including responses, parameters, request body, and callbacks.

methods.name: get_fields_from_routes
methods.description: Collects all relevant ModelFields from a list of routes for schema generation.

methods.name: get_openapi
methods.description: Generates the complete OpenAPI schema document for a set of routes and webhooks.
